body.text: Coins whose own metadata describes a launchpad or token-launch tool. Launch (LAUNCH, LaunchLab, Solana): "Launch launches coins on StonkFun, which runs on Raydium LaunchLab." A GeckoTerminal post of 2026-10-26 05:46 UTC (e2:1) says $LAUNCH is trending as a launchpad built on StonkFun that calls out Pump.fun, with anti-copycat rules, no dev buys and creator fees used to buy back and burn each coin; a checker account's scan (e3:2) says the fee burn of LAUNCH itself was not seen on-chain. RAYDIUM LAUNCHPAD (RAYPAD, LaunchLab): "A Launchpad the way it should be: no snipers, no copycats, and every fee burns your coin forever." Posts of 2026-10-26 (e3:2, e3:3) describe it as a Raydium launchpad with a buyback-and-burn vault and a copy of the Launch idea; the same checker says the burn vault is unverified. notrandom (NTRNDM, Pump.fun): "Non-random pumpfun CA launcher, and custom Solana wallet addresses." Its site (notrandom.fun, e3:0) sells custom contract addresses for pump.fun coins and lets a creator pair a coin with $NTRNDM to set creator rewards of up to 3%; @notrandomdotfun posts runner alerts for NTRNDM (e3:1). Hooked (HOOKED, Meteora DBC): "Launch a token with rules built into the token itself. Solana runs the transfer hook on every trade." NTRNDM (created about 2026-10-10) and HOOKED (about 2026-10-03) are older than the LAUNCH and RAYPAD wave (18 and 3 hours old at discovery). Every description and fee-burn claim is the project's own; none is verified here, and the four coins are separate products with no shown link to each other.

Most recent observation of the story (Oct 26, 2026): New today. Posts of 2026-10-25 and 2026-10-26 (e2:1, e3:2, e3:3) discuss LAUNCH, a coin that says it launches coins on StonkFun, and RAYPAD, a copy-style launchpad coin on Raydium; notrandom.fun (e3:0) and Hooked are older launch-tool coins whose metadata describes launching tokens. The four coins share a theme (the coin is itself a launchpad or launch tool) but are separate products; LAUNCH traded about 5x its market cap and rose about 2,500% in the sweep, so treat its volume as young-coin trading. Fee-burn and reward claims are the projects' own and one checker account says LAUNCH's own burn was not seen. NTRNDM and HOOKED predate the wave.
